b1-llegadaeuropeos-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Columbus at sea
b1-llegadaeuropeos-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have read a book about the voyage of 1492, and he asks what life on board was like.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what the sailors were doing while the ships crossed the Atlantic.
cues: Say what the ships were doing
b1-llegadaeuropeos-01.target: Mientras los barcos cruzaban el Atlántico, los marineros tenían miedo.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-01.english: While the ships were crossing the Atlantic, the sailors were afraid.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-01.canDo: I can say what was going on while something else happened, using mientras.

b1-llegadaeuropeos-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The first encounter
b1-llegadaeuropeos-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have visited a museum about the Taíno, and she asks how the first meeting went.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-02.prompt: Tell Meg how the first encounter began and how it changed.
cues: Say that it was peaceful at first
Contrast it with what soon happened
b1-llegadaeuropeos-02.target: Al principio el encuentro fue pacífico. Sin embargo, pronto empezaron los conflictos.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-02.english: At first the encounter was peaceful. However, conflicts soon began.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-02.canDo: I can contrast two ideas with sin embargo and no obstante.

b1-llegadaeuropeos-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Hatuey
b1-llegadaeuropeos-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have watched a documentary about Hatuey, and he asks what you thought of his story.
cues: Say that Hatuey and his men were fewer
Say that they resisted anyway, using a pesar de que
b1-llegadaeuropeos-03.target: A pesar de que eran menos, Hatuey y sus hombres resistieron.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-03.english: Although they were fewer, Hatuey and his men resisted.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-03.canDo: I can express concession with a pesar de que and a pesar de.

b1-llegadaeuropeos-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The epidemics
b1-llegadaeuropeos-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg have gone to a class about the Columbian exchange, and she asks why the population fell.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-04.prompt: Tell Meg what many historians say about the epidemics.
cues: Say that a large part of the population died because of the epidemics
b1-llegadaeuropeos-04.target: Según muchos historiadores, debido a las epidemias murió una gran parte de la población.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-04.english: According to many historians, a large part of the population died because of the epidemics.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-04.canDo: I can give causes with debido a and a raíz de.

b1-llegadaeuropeos-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A debated figure
b1-llegadaeuropeos-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have read a book about 1492, and he asks if anyone knows how many people lived in the Americas then.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what is uncertain about the population before 1492.
cues: Say that it is not certain
b1-llegadaeuropeos-05.target: No es seguro que podamos conocer la cifra exacta.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-05.english: It is not certain that we can know the exact figure.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-05.canDo: I can express doubt and possibility with es posible que, no es seguro que and quizás.

b1-llegadaeuropeos-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Columbus and Asia
b1-llegadaeuropeos-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just watched a documentary about Columbus, and he asks what surprised you.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos what Columbus thought while he explored the islands and what he believed at the end of his life.
cues: Say what he thought while he explored
Say what he still believed when he died in 1506
b1-llegadaeuropeos-consolidation.target: Mientras Colón exploraba las islas, pensaba que estaba cerca de Asia. Colón murió en 1506 y todavía creía que había llegado a Asia.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-consolidation.english: While Columbus was exploring the islands, he thought he was near Asia. Columbus died in 1506 and still believed he had reached Asia.
b1-llegadaeuropeos-consolidation.canDo: I can tell the story of 1492 and its consequences in the Caribbean.
